findings.summary: PENDING_CLUE_STATUSES in tick.ts:165 is a hand-copied partition of the CLUE_STATUSES enum into pending vs terminal groups. It is outside the spec's scope (which targets field names, kinds, and transitions in src/protocol.ts), but a registry-added status would not auto-update this list.

npm run verify:protocol is not wired into the dd-acceptance command set (npm ci / typecheck / test / smoke:cas). The command exists and its core logic (verifyConsumerContract) is exercised discriminatively in tests, but the CLI itself is not run as a CI gate. The spec requires the check command to exist and be machine-runnable, not necessarily to be in acceptance.
